certificate_check_code:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pepflow as pf

certificate_checked = False
certificate_keys = ("N_verify", "params_json", "relaxed_constraints", "S_matrix", "S_row_names", "S_col_names", "basis_vectors", "basis_scalars", "opt_value", "tau_sol", "tau_name", "named_dual_values", "constraint_metadata", "normalization", "certificate_provenance", "numerical_checks", "numerical_decomposition")
digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({key: certificate[key] for key in certificate_keys}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()
assert digest == certificate["certificate_id"]
assert certificate["closed_form_search"]["completed"]
assert certificate["certificate_provenance"]["pep_type"] == "primal"
assert Path(pf.__file__).resolve() == Path(certificate["pepflow_file"]).resolve()
assert N_int == certificate["N_verify"]
assert params_sp == json.loads(certificate["params_json"])
assert pb.ctx is ctx
assert set(pb.relaxed_constraints) == set(certificate["relaxed_constraints"])
basis = list(ctx.basis_vectors())
basis_labels = [str(v) for v in basis]
assert basis_labels == certificate["basis_vectors"] == certificate["S_row_names"] == certificate["S_col_names"]
assert [str(v) for v in ctx.basis_scalars()] == certificate["basis_scalars"]
pm = pf.ExpressionManager(ctx, resolve_parameters=params_sp)
tol = certificate["numerical_checks"]["tolerances"]
S_array = np.asarray(certificate["S_matrix"], dtype=float)
assert np.all(np.isfinite(S_array)) and S_array.shape == (len(basis), len(basis))
assert np.allclose(S_array, S_array.T, atol=tol["psd_tol"], rtol=0)
assert np.linalg.eigvalsh(S_array).min() >= -tol["psd_tol"]
S_sol = pf.MatrixWithNames(S_array, basis_labels, basis_labels)
S_scalar = sum((float(S_array[i, j])*basis[i]*basis[j] for i, j in np.ndindex(S_array.shape)), pf.Scalar.zero())
records = [(c, "initial", None, None) for c in pb.init_conditions]
for owner in ctx.func_to_triplets:
    groups = ctx.get_constraint_data(owner)
    records.extend((c, "interpolation", str(owner), str(group)) for group, family in groups.sc_dict.items() for c in family)
    records.extend((c, "interpolation", str(owner), str(group)) for group, c in groups.psd_dict.items())
assert len({c.name for c, *_ in records}) == len(records)
assert {c.name for c, *_ in records} == set(certificate["constraint_metadata"]) == set(certificate["named_dual_values"])
weighted_terms, interpolation_terms, extra_terms, extra_duals = {}, {}, {}, {}
constraints_by_name = {}
saved_duals = certificate["named_dual_values"]
tau_name = certificate["tau_name"]
for c, origin, owner, group in records:
    assert isinstance(c, pf.ScalarConstraint), "This case has only scalar interpolation inequalities."
    constraints_by_name[c.name] = c
    dropped = c.name in pb.relaxed_constraints
    expected_meta = dict(origin=origin, owner=owner, group=group, kind="scalar", comparator=c.cmp.value, shape=[], relaxed=dropped)
    assert certificate["constraint_metadata"][c.name] == expected_meta
    value = saved_duals[c.name]
    if dropped:
        assert value is None
        continue
    assert value is not None and np.isfinite(value)
    if c.cmp != pf.Comparator.EQ:
        assert value >= -tol["dual_tol"]
    residual = c.lhs-c.rhs
    if c.cmp in (pf.Comparator.GE, pf.Comparator.SEQ):
        residual = -residual
    weighted_terms[c.name] = float(value)*residual
    if origin == "interpolation":
        interpolation_terms[c.name] = weighted_terms[c.name]
    elif c.name != tau_name:
        extra_terms[c.name] = weighted_terms[c.name]
        extra_duals[c.name] = value
assert certificate["normalization"]["initial_condition"] == "||x_0-x_star||^2 <= R^2"
assert certificate["normalization"]["performance_metric"] == "F(y_N)-F(x_star)"
assert abs(saved_duals[tau_name]-certificate["tau_sol"]) <= tol["dual_tol"]
assert abs(certificate["normalization"]["bound_value"]-certificate["opt_value"]) <= tol["identity_atol"]
certificate_diff = pb.performance_metric-certificate["opt_value"]-sum(weighted_terms.values(), pf.Scalar.zero())+S_scalar
checked = pm.eval_scalar(certificate_diff)
certificate_residuals = {}
for label, coords in (("Gram", checked.inner_prod_coords), ("function", checked.func_coords), ("offset", checked.offset)):
    error = float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(coords, dtype=float)), initial=0))
    certificate_residuals[label] = error
    assert error <= tol["identity_atol"], (label, error)
D_saved = np.asarray(certificate["numerical_decomposition"]["D"], dtype=float)
E_saved = np.asarray(certificate["numerical_decomposition"]["ell_coords"], dtype=float)
assert certificate["numerical_decomposition"]["basis_labels"] == basis_labels
assert E_saved.shape[1] == len(basis) and D_saved.shape == (E_saved.shape[0], E_saved.shape[0])
assert np.all(np.isfinite(D_saved)) and np.all(np.isfinite(E_saved))
assert np.allclose(E_saved.T @ D_saved @ E_saved, S_array, atol=tol["reconstruction_atol"], rtol=tol["reconstruction_rtol"])
certificate_checked = True
print("Recomputed certificate residuals:", certificate_residuals)
grouping_code:
# Every interpolation residual is <= 0; subtract only numerically PSD S pieces.
grouping_checked = False
rank_tolerance = 1e-4
group_terms = dict(interpolation_terms)
term_assignment = {}
def assign_term(owner, first, second, step):
    if ctx[first] is not ctx[second]:
        term_assignment[f"{owner}:{ctx[first]},{ctx[second]}"] = step-1
for j in range(1,N_int+1):
    assign_term("f", "x_star", f"x_{j-1}", j)
    assign_term("f", "x_star", f"y_{j}", j)
    assign_term("f", f"x_{j-1}", f"y_{j}", j)
    assign_term("g", "x_star", f"y_{j}", j)
    if j>1:
        assign_term("f", f"y_{j-1}", f"x_{j-1}", j)
        assign_term("g", f"y_{j-1}", f"y_{j}", j)
# The one coincident interpolation constraint is split into its two positive roles.
assert set(term_assignment) == set(group_terms)
split_name = f"f:{ctx['x_star']},{ctx['y_1']}"
split_value = saved_duals[f"g:{ctx['x_star']},{ctx['y_1']}"]-saved_duals[f"f:{ctx['x_0']},{ctx['y_1']}"]
split_residual = constraints_by_name[split_name].lhs-constraints_by_name[split_name].rhs
assert 0<=split_value<=saved_duals[split_name]
del group_terms[split_name]
del term_assignment[split_name]
group_terms[split_name+"::first"] = split_value*split_residual
group_terms[split_name+"::second"] = (saved_duals[split_name]-split_value)*split_residual
term_assignment[split_name+"::first"] = 0
term_assignment[split_name+"::second"] = 1
split_parent = {split_name+"::first":split_name,split_name+"::second":split_name}
split_difference = pm.eval_scalar(sum(group_terms.values(),pf.Scalar.zero())-sum(interpolation_terms.values(),pf.Scalar.zero()))
for coords in (split_difference.inner_prod_coords,split_difference.func_coords,split_difference.offset):
    assert np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(coords,dtype=float)),initial=0)<=tol["identity_atol"]
S_assignment = dict(direct_steps)
assert set(S_assignment) == set(S_piece_terms)
lyap = [pf.Scalar.zero()]
partial_sum = pf.Scalar.zero()
for step in range(N_int):
    partial_sum += sum((group_terms[name] for name,target in term_assignment.items() if target==step), pf.Scalar.zero())
    partial_sum -= sum((S_piece_terms[name] for name,target in S_assignment.items() if target==step), pf.Scalar.zero())
    lyap.append(partial_sum)
ranks = []
for k,Vk in enumerate(lyap):
    M = np.asarray(pm.eval_scalar(Vk).inner_prod_coords,dtype=float)
    rank = int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(M,tol=rank_tolerance))
    ranks.append(rank)
    print(f"rank V_{k}: {rank}")
    if k==0:
        print()
print("Interior rank is constant:",len(set(ranks[1:N_int]))==1)
assert len(set(ranks[1:N_int]))==1
boundary_names, boundary_S = [], []
coverage_diff = lyap[N_int]-(sum(group_terms.values(),pf.Scalar.zero())-S_scalar)
coverage = pm.eval_scalar(coverage_diff)
coverage_errors = {}
for label,coords in (("Gram",coverage.inner_prod_coords),("function",coverage.func_coords),("offset",coverage.offset)):
    error = float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(coords,dtype=float)),initial=0))
    coverage_errors[label] = error
    assert error<=tol["identity_atol"]
for k in range(N_int):
    increment = sum((group_terms[name] for name,step in term_assignment.items() if step==k),pf.Scalar.zero())
    increment -= sum((S_piece_terms[name] for name,step in S_assignment.items() if step==k),pf.Scalar.zero())
    value = pm.eval_scalar(lyap[k+1]-lyap[k]-increment)
    for coords in (value.inner_prod_coords,value.func_coords,value.offset):
        assert np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(coords,dtype=float)),initial=0)<=tol["identity_atol"]
grouping_checked = True
print("Full-coordinate coverage:",coverage_errors)
print("Numerical direction: V_(k+1)-V_k is a nonnegative sum of nonpositive residuals minus PSD pieces.")

step.derivation: The notebook constructs the actual composite proximal update and momentum relation. Three position-matrix equations solve jointly for c_new,d_new,E. Substitution into the original expression gives exact zero Gram, function-value, and constant residuals; no floating coefficients are permitted.

base.argument: A separate context encodes the genuine first proximal step. Both complete scalar identities are checked exactly. The initial Q formula and delayed-square coefficient are separately checked. All terms involving a_0 vanish without evaluating g(y_0).

boundary.argument: The terminal update has its own square coefficient and omits the entire final quadratic. Every residual component is exactly zero for symbolic N>=2,L>0. The N=2 delayed-square correction is checked separately; N=1 is the base certificate.

signs.argument: h_j>0 and B_j=sum_(i=1)^j h_i>0 for 1<=j<=N; C_j>=H_N>=1. Thus a_j,b_j,a_j-b_j>0. mu_1/2=tau>0; for j>=2, mu_j=[B_(j-1)(j-2)/4+h_j*C_(j-1)]/[C_(j-1)(C_j+1)]>0, hence a_j-a_(j-1)=mu_j+b_j>0. Interior E_j has an exact positive numerator polynomial after m=N-j,t=j-2 substitution: its full 7-by-9 coefficient table has 42 positive nonzero entries and positive constant 116736. Denominator 128N(N+1)(j+2)^2[2N^2+10N+4-j^2-7j] is positive because its last factor becomes j^2+3j+4+4jm+2m^2+10m. E_1=0 and E_N=H_N(H_N-1)/2>=0. These facts make all interpolation weights and subtracted square coefficients nonnegative.
signs.direction: I_f,I_g<=0, so T_j-S_j<=0. The delayed base omits exactly an existing positive square and the next increment subtracts it. Therefore V_N<=...<=V_1<=V_0=0.

domain.argument: All denominators and index ranges are justified for integer N>=1,L>0. H_0=0 is treated as an exceptional definition; the interior polynomial H_j is used only on its stated range. Composite stationarity imposes s_star=-grad f(x_star) rather than separate minimization. Proximal outputs belong to dom g; g(y_0) is never evaluated. The proof uses finite inner-product sums and smooth/convex interpolation, so it holds in any nonzero real Hilbert space. No division by R is used and R=0 is included.

normalization.argument: A separate symbolic scalar calculation verifies all Gram, function, and offset coordinates. L>0,tau>0 and the radius constraint give the final inequality. The exact rational rate is checked symbolically.

sharpness.argument: For R>0 choose a unit vector v, f=0, g(x)=LR/(2H_N)*|<v,x>|, x_star=0,x_0=Rv. With q=R/(2H_N), the proximal sequence is y_j=(R-H_j*q)v>=Rv/2 along v; the H recurrence is checked exactly, including its two initial increments. Thus F(y_N)=LR^2/(4H_N). For R=0 the zero functions attain equality.

lyapunov_formula_latex:
### Theorem

Let $\mathcal H$ be a nonzero real Hilbert space, $L>0$, $R\geq0$, and $N\geq1$ an integer. Let $f$ be convex with $L$-Lipschitz gradient, and $g$ be closed, proper, and convex. Suppose $0\in\nabla f(x_{\star})+\partial g(x_{\star})$ and $\|x_{0}-x_{\star}\|\leq R$. Set $F=f+g$ and
$$y_{0}=x_{0},\qquad
y_{k+1}=\operatorname{prox}_{g/L}\!\left(x_{k}-\frac{\nabla f(x_{k})}L\right),\qquad
x_{k+1}=y_{k+1}+\frac{k}{k+3}(y_{k+1}-y_{k}),\quad 0\leq k<N.$$
The proximal updates are well-defined. No initial value of $g(x_{0})$ is required.

Define the following explicit coefficients:
$$H_{0}=0,\qquad H_{j}=\frac{j^2+5j+2}{8}\ (j\geq1),\qquad C_{j}=2H_{N}-H_{j},\qquad \tau=\frac1{4H_{N}},$$
$$B_{j}=\frac{j(j+3)}4-\frac{j(j-1)(j+1)(j+2)}{8N(N+1)},\qquad
h_{j}=\frac{j+1}{2}\left(1-\frac{j(j-1)}{N(N+1)}\right),$$
$$a_{j}=\frac{B_{j}}{C_{j}}\quad(0\leq j\leq N),\qquad
c_{k+1}=\frac{B_{k+1}}{2(C_{k+1}+1)},\qquad
d_{k}=\frac{a_{k}C_{k+1}-(h_{k+1}-1)}{2C_{k}}\quad(1\leq k<N).$$
In particular, $a_{0}=0$ and $a_{N}=1$. Write $e_{k}=y_{k}-x_{\star}$, $\Delta_{k}=F(y_{k})-F(x_{\star})$, and $u_{0}=(\nabla f(x_{0})-\nabla f(x_{\star}))/L$. Set
$$Q_{k}=c_{k+1}\|x_{k}-x_{\star}\|^2-a_{k}\langle e_{k},x_{k}-x_{\star}\rangle+d_{k}\|e_{k}\|^2
\quad(1\leq k<N),\qquad Q_{N}=0.$$
The full Lyapunov function is
$$\boxed{\quad V_{0}=0,\qquad
V_{k}=\frac{a_{k}}{L}\Delta_{k}+Q_{k}-\tau\|e_{0}\|^2+
\mathbf 1_{\{N\geq2,\ k=1\}}\tau\|u_{0}\|^2,\quad 1\leq k\leq N.\quad}$$
The indicator is one exactly at the first checkpoint when a second step exists. At that checkpoint,
$$Q_{1}=\frac{C_{1}-1}{2C_{1}^2}\|e_{1}\|^2\qquad(N\geq2).$$
All coefficients are defined on their stated ranges, and $C_{j}\geq H_{N}\geq1$ for $0\leq j\leq N$.

This sequence is nonincreasing. Consequently,
$$\boxed{\quad F(y_{N})-F(x_{\star})\leq L\tau R^2
=\frac{2LR^2}{N^2+5N+2}.\quad}$$
The statement includes $R=0$ and $N=1$, and uses only Hilbert-space inner-product identities.
proof_outline_latex:
### Proof outline

Use the explicit coefficients from the theorem, with $e_{k}=y_{k}-x_{\star}$, $\Delta_{k}=F(y_{k})-F(x_{\star})$, and $u_{0}=(\nabla f(x_{0})-\nabla f(x_{\star}))/L$. The full potential to be proved nonincreasing is
$$V_{0}=0,\qquad V_{k}=\frac{a_{k}}{L}\Delta_{k}+Q_{k}-\tau\|e_{0}\|^{2}+\mathbf 1_{\{N\geq2,\ k=1\}}\tau\|u_{0}\|^{2},\qquad 1\leq k\leq N,$$
$$Q_{k}=c_{k+1}\|x_{k}-x_{\star}\|^{2}-a_{k}\langle e_{k},x_{k}-x_{\star}\rangle+d_{k}\|e_{k}\|^{2}\quad(1\leq k<N),\qquad Q_{N}=0.$$


For available points $u,v$, use the nonpositive interpolation residuals
$$I_{f}(u,v)=\frac{f(v)-f(u)+\langle\nabla f(v),u-v\rangle}{L}
+\frac{\|\nabla f(v)-\nabla f(u)\|^2}{2L^2}\leq0,$$
$$I_{g}(u,v)=\frac{g(v)-g(u)+\langle s_{v},u-v\rangle}{L}\leq0,\qquad s_{v}\in\partial g(v).$$
Composite stationarity allows $s_{\star}=-\nabla f(x_{\star})$; neither gradient need vanish separately.

At step $j=1,\ldots,N$, proximal optimality gives
$$s_{j}=L(x_{j-1}-y_{j})-\nabla f(x_{j-1})\in\partial g(y_{j}).$$
Define $b_{j}=a_{j}/(C_{j}+1)$, $\mu_{j}=a_{j}-a_{j-1}-b_{j}$, and
$$u_{j}=\frac{\nabla f(x_{j-1})-\nabla f(x_{\star})}{L},\qquad
p_{j}=\frac{\nabla f(y_{j})-\nabla f(x_{\star})}{L},\qquad
r_{j}=\frac{\nabla f(y_{j})+s_{j}}{L},\qquad
t_{j}=\frac{e_{j}}{C_{j}}-\frac{e_{j-1}}{C_{j-1}}.$$
Here $u_{1}=u_{0}$ from the theorem. For $j\geq2$, put $\beta_{j}=(j-2)/(j+1)$. The remaining square coefficient is
$$E_{1}=0,\qquad E_{N}=\frac{H_{N}(H_{N}-1)}2\quad(N\geq2),$$
$$E_{j}=\frac12\left[
B_{j-1}C_{j}-\beta_{j+1}C_{j-1}h_{j+1}
-\frac{B_{j+1}\beta_{j+1}^2C_{j-1}^2}{C_{j+1}+1}
\right]\qquad(2\leq j<N).$$

Define the complete weighted interpolation expression
$$\begin{aligned}
T_{j}={}&\mu_{j} I_{f}(x_{\star},x_{j-1})+b_{j} I_{f}(x_{\star},y_{j})
+(a_{j}-b_{j})I_{f}(x_{j-1},y_{j})\\
&+(a_{j}-a_{j-1})I_{g}(x_{\star},y_{j})
+a_{j-1}\bigl[I_{f}(y_{j-1},x_{j-1})+I_{g}(y_{j-1},y_{j})\bigr],
\end{aligned}$$
and the complete local square expression
$$\begin{aligned}
S_{j}={}&\frac{a_{j}-b_{j}}{2}\left\|r_{j}-\frac{e_{j}}{C_{j}}\right\|^2
+\frac{\mu_{j}}{2}\|u_{j}\|^2+\frac{b_{j}}{2}\|p_{j}\|^2+E_{j}\|t_{j}\|^2\\
&+\frac{a_{j-1}}2
\left\|\frac{\nabla f(y_{j-1})-\nabla f(x_{j-1})}{L}\right\|^2.
\end{aligned}$$
Every term multiplied by $a_{0}=0$ is omitted at $j=1$; in particular, $g(y_{0})$ is never used.

The position part of the potential is
$$W_{j}=\frac{a_{j}}{L}\Delta_{j}+
c_{j+1}\|x_{j}-x_{\star}\|^2-a_{j}\langle e_{j},x_{j}-x_{\star}\rangle+
d_{j}\|e_{j}\|^2-\tau\|e_{0}\|^2\quad(j<N),$$
with $W_{N}=\Delta_{N}/L-\tau\|e_{0}\|^2$. Exact coefficient matching yields
$$W_{1}=T_{1}-S_{1},\qquad W_{j}-W_{j-1}=T_{j}-S_{j}\quad(2\leq j\leq N).$$
The terminal identity uses $Q_{N}=0$ and its own value of $E_{N}$. For $N=1$, the first identity is already the full certificate.

For $N\geq2$, delay only the first input-gradient square. Since $\mu_{1}/2=\tau$, the theorem's potential satisfies
$$V_{1}=T_{1}-\bigl(S_{1}-\tau\|u_{0}\|^2\bigr),\qquad
V_{2}-V_{1}=T_{2}-S_{2}-\tau\|u_{0}\|^2,$$
$$V_{j}-V_{j-1}=T_{j}-S_{j}\qquad(3\leq j\leq N).$$
All interpolation weights and square coefficients are nonnegative. The sign lemma below proves this on the full index domain, including an exact positive-coefficient polynomial certificate for $E_{j}$. Thus these displayed increments are nonpositive and
$$\frac{\Delta_{N}}{L}-\tau\|e_{0}\|^2=V_{N}\leq V_{0}=0.$$
Finally, $\|e_{0}\|^2\leq R^2$ gives the stated rate. No division by $R$ occurs, so the argument also covers zero radius.

# Domain: integer 2 <= j < N. All coefficients below are rational functions of j,N.
ctx_step = pf.PEPContext("symbolic_step").set_as_current()
Ls = pf.Parameter("L_{step}")
fs = pf.SmoothConvexFunction(is_basis=True, tags=["f_{step}"], L=Ls)
gs = pf.ConvexFunction(is_basis=True, tags=["g_{step}"])
Fs = fs + gs
star = Fs.set_stationary_point("x_{star}")
yp = pf.Vector(is_basis=True, tags=["y_{j-1}"])
yo = pf.Vector(is_basis=True, tags=["y_{j-2}"])
yn = pf.Vector(is_basis=True, tags=["y_j"])
coef_names = [
    "a",
    "ap",
    "b",
    "E",
    "C",
    "Cp",
    "beta",
    "betan",
    "cprev",
    "dprev",
    "cnew",
    "dnew",
]
pars = {name: pf.Parameter(name + "_{step}") for name in coef_names}
xp = yp + pars["beta"] * (yp - yo)
xp.add_tag("x_{j-1}")
fs(yp)
gs(yp)
hx = fs.grad(xp)
gs.add_point_with_grad_restriction(yn, Ls * (xp - yn) - hx)
fs(yn)
ep, en = yp - star, yn - star
xn = yn + pars["betan"] * (yn - yp)
u = (hx - fs.grad(star)) / Ls
p = (fs.grad(yn) - fs.grad(star)) / Ls
r = (fs.grad(yn) + gs.grad(yn)) / Ls
t = en / pars["C"] - ep / pars["Cp"]


def If(v, w):
    return normalized_f_residual(fs, v, w, Ls, ctx_step)


def Ig(v, w):
    return normalized_g_residual(gs, v, w, Ls, ctx_step)


Tstep = (
    (pars["a"] - pars["ap"] - pars["b"]) * If(star, xp)
    + pars["b"] * If(star, yn)
    + (pars["a"] - pars["b"]) * If(xp, yn)
    + (pars["a"] - pars["ap"]) * Ig(star, yn)
    + pars["ap"] * (If(yp, xp) + Ig(yp, yn))
)
Sstep = (
    (pars["a"] - pars["b"]) / 2 * (r - en / pars["C"]) ** 2
    + (pars["a"] - pars["ap"] - pars["b"]) / 2 * u**2
    + pars["b"] / 2 * p**2
    + pars["ap"] / 2 * ((fs.grad(yp) - hx) / Ls) ** 2
    + pars["E"] * t**2
)
Wprev = (
    pars["ap"] * (Fs(yp) - Fs(star)) / Ls
    + pars["cprev"] * (xp - star) ** 2
    - pars["ap"] * (ep * (xp - star))
    + pars["dprev"] * ep**2
)
Wnew = (
    pars["a"] * (Fs(yn) - Fs(star)) / Ls
    + pars["cnew"] * (xn - star) ** 2
    - pars["a"] * (en * (xn - star))
    + pars["dnew"] * en**2
)
LHS_step = Wnew - Wprev
RHS_step = Tstep - Sstep
diff_step = LHS_step - RHS_step
resolved_step = {
    "L_{step}": L_s,
    "a_{step}": aas(j_s, n_s),
    "ap_{step}": aas(j_s - 1, n_s),
    "b_{step}": bbs(j_s, n_s),
    "E_{step}": es(j_s, n_s),
    "C_{step}": Cs(j_s, n_s),
    "Cp_{step}": Cs(j_s - 1, n_s),
    "beta_{step}": betas(j_s),
    "betan_{step}": betas(j_s + 1),
    "cprev_{step}": ccs(j_s, n_s),
    "dprev_{step}": dds(j_s - 1, n_s),
    "cnew_{step}": ccs(j_s + 1, n_s),
    "dnew_{step}": dds(j_s, n_s),
}
pm_step = pf.ExpressionManager(ctx_step, resolve_parameters=resolved_step)
resolved_step = {key: sp.factor(value) for key, value in resolved_step.items()}
pm_step = pf.ExpressionManager(ctx_step, resolve_parameters=resolved_step)
# Extract and solve the actual three coefficient equations for the new local terms.
c_unknown, d_unknown, E_unknown = sp.symbols("c_new d_new E_j")
unknown_map = {
    **resolved_step,
    "cnew_{step}": c_unknown,
    "dnew_{step}": d_unknown,
    "E_{step}": E_unknown,
}
unknown_manager = pf.ExpressionManager(ctx_step, resolve_parameters=unknown_map)
raw = unknown_manager.eval_scalar(diff_step, sympy_mode=True)
index_new = unknown_manager.get_index_of_basis_vector(yn)
index_prev = unknown_manager.get_index_of_basis_vector(yp)
equations = [
    sp.cancel(raw.inner_prod_coords[i, k])
    for i, k in [
        (index_new, index_new),
        (index_new, index_prev),
        (index_prev, index_prev),
    ]
]
solution = sp.solve(
    equations, [c_unknown, d_unknown, E_unknown], dict=True, simplify=False
)[0]
expected = {
    c_unknown: ccs(j_s + 1, n_s),
    d_unknown: dds(j_s, n_s),
    E_unknown: es(j_s, n_s),
}
for unknown in expected:
    assert sp.cancel(solution[unknown] - expected[unknown]) == 0
print(
    "Coefficient equations uniquely give c_(j+1), d_j and E_j in the displayed formulas."
)
analytic_formula_sources.sign-check:
# Exact difference identities behind the weights, valid for 2<=j<=N.
identities = {
    "B increment": Bs(j_s, n_s) - Bs(j_s - 1, n_s) - hs(j_s, n_s),
    "h adjoint recurrence": hs(j_s, n_s) - betas(j_s + 1) * hs(j_s + 1, n_s) - 1,
    "H increment": Hs(j_s) - Hs(j_s - 1) - (j_s + 2) / 4,
    "lambda positive decomposition": aas(j_s, n_s)
    - aas(j_s - 1, n_s)
    - bbs(j_s, n_s)
    - (Bs(j_s - 1, n_s) * (j_s - 2) / 4 + hs(j_s, n_s) * Cs(j_s - 1, n_s))
    / (Cs(j_s - 1, n_s) * (Cs(j_s, n_s) + 1)),
    "terminal a": aas(n_s, n_s) - 1,
    "initial delayed coefficient": (aas(sp.S(1), n_s) - bbs(sp.S(1), n_s)) / 2
    - sp.S(1) / (4 * Hs(n_s)),
    "initial Q compatibility": ccs(sp.S(2), n_s)
    - aas(sp.S(1), n_s)
    + dds(sp.S(1), n_s)
    - (Cs(sp.S(1), n_s) - 1) / (2 * Cs(sp.S(1), n_s) ** 2),
}
for label, expression in identities.items():
    residual = sp.cancel(expression)
    assert residual == 0, label
    print(label + ":", residual)

# E_j positivity by an exact polynomial with nonnegative coefficients.
# t=j-2>=0 and m=N-j>=0; this proves a domain slightly larger than j<N.
t_s, m_s = sp.symbols("t m", nonnegative=True, integer=True)
Q_E = 2 * n_s**2 + 10 * n_s + 4 - j_s**2 - 7 * j_s
den_E = 128 * n_s * (n_s + 1) * (j_s + 2) ** 2 * Q_E
num_E = sp.cancel(es(j_s, n_s) * den_E)
assert sp.denom(num_E) == 1
positive_polynomial = sp.Poly(
    sp.expand(num_E.subs(n_s, j_s + m_s).subs(j_s, t_s + 2)), m_s, t_s
)
assert all(coef > 0 for coef in positive_polynomial.coeffs())
assert positive_polynomial.eval({m_s: 0, t_s: 0}) > 0
coefficient_table = np.zeros(
    (positive_polynomial.degree(m_s) + 1, positive_polynomial.degree(t_s) + 1),
    dtype=object,
)
for (m_power, t_power), coef in positive_polynomial.terms():
    coefficient_table[m_power, t_power] = coef
print("P(m,t) coefficient table: row m-power, column t-power.")
pf.pprint_labeled_matrix(
    coefficient_table,
    [f"m^{{{i}}}" for i in range(coefficient_table.shape[0])],
    [f"t^{{{i}}}" for i in range(coefficient_table.shape[1])],
    precision=0,
)
assert sp.cancel(es(j_s, n_s) - num_E / den_E) == 0
assert (
    sp.expand(Q_E.subs(n_s, j_s + m_s))
    == j_s**2 + 3 * j_s + 4 + 4 * j_s * m_s + 2 * m_s**2 + 10 * m_s
)
print(
    "E_j: positive numerator polynomial and positive denominator; endpoint E_1=0, E_N=H_N(H_N-1)/2>=0."
)
proof_checks["signs"] = True
proof_checks["domain"] = True
analytic_formula_sources.step-check:
LHS_step = Wnew - Wprev
RHS_step = Tstep - Sstep
diff_step = LHS_step - RHS_step
proof_checks["step"] = verify_exact("Interior step", diff_step, pm_step)
# The delayed first square changes V_1 by +tau*||u_0||^2 and step 2 by its negative.
u_initial = pf.Vector(is_basis=True, tags=["u_{initial}"])
delay = pf.Parameter("tau_{step}") * u_initial**2
delay_manager = pf.ExpressionManager(
    ctx_step, resolve_parameters={**resolved_step, "tau_{step}": 1 / (4 * Hs(n_s))}
)
verify_exact(
    "Delayed-square step-2 correction",
    (Wnew - (Wprev + delay)) - ((Tstep - Sstep) - delay) - diff_step,
    delay_manager,
)
analytic_formula_sources.base-check:
# Base, N>=2, with the delayed input-gradient square retained in V_1.
ctx_base = pf.PEPContext("symbolic_base").set_as_current()
Lb = pf.Parameter("L_{base}")
fb = pf.SmoothConvexFunction(is_basis=True, tags=["f_{base}"], L=Lb)
gb = pf.ConvexFunction(is_basis=True, tags=["g_{base}"])
Fb = fb + gb
star_b = Fb.set_stationary_point("x_{star}")
x0_b = pf.Vector(is_basis=True, tags=["x_0"])
hb = fb.grad(x0_b)
y1_b = gb.prox(x0_b - hb / Lb, 1 / Lb, tag="y_1")
fb(y1_b)
eb = y1_b - star_b
e0b = x0_b - star_b
ub = (hb - fb.grad(star_b)) / Lb
pbv = (fb.grad(y1_b) - fb.grad(star_b)) / Lb
rb = (fb.grad(y1_b) + gb.grad(y1_b)) / Lb
Ab, Bb, Cb, Tb = (
    pf.Parameter("a_{base}"),
    pf.Parameter("b_{base}"),
    pf.Parameter("C_{base}"),
    pf.Parameter("tau_{base}"),
)


def Ifb(v, w):
    return normalized_f_residual(fb, v, w, Lb, ctx_base)


def Igb(v, w):
    return normalized_g_residual(gb, v, w, Lb, ctx_base)


Tbase = (
    (Ab - Bb) * Ifb(star_b, x0_b)
    + Bb * Ifb(star_b, y1_b)
    + (Ab - Bb) * Ifb(x0_b, y1_b)
    + Ab * Igb(star_b, y1_b)
)
Sbase = (Ab - Bb) / 2 * (rb - eb / Cb) ** 2 + (Ab - Bb) / 2 * ub**2 + Bb / 2 * pbv**2
W1base = (
    Ab * (Fb(y1_b) - Fb(star_b)) / Lb + (Cb - 1) / (2 * Cb**2) * eb**2 - Tb * e0b**2
)
LHS_base = W1base + Tb * ub**2
RHS_base = Tbase - (Sbase - Tb * ub**2)
diff_base = LHS_base - RHS_base
resolved_base = {
    "L_{base}": L_s,
    "C_{base}": 2 * Hs(n_s) - 1,
    "a_{base}": 1 / (2 * Hs(n_s) - 1),
    "b_{base}": 1 / ((2 * Hs(n_s) - 1) * 2 * Hs(n_s)),
    "tau_{base}": 1 / (4 * Hs(n_s)),
}
pm_base = pf.ExpressionManager(ctx_base, resolve_parameters=resolved_base)
proof_checks["base"] = verify_exact("Base (N>=2)", diff_base, pm_base)
# N=1 has no delayed square and no position remainder; verify independently.
small_base_map = {
    key: sp.cancel(value.subs(n_s, 1)) if isinstance(value, sp.Basic) else value
    for key, value in resolved_base.items()
}
pm_one = pf.ExpressionManager(ctx_base, resolve_parameters=small_base_map)
LHS_one = (Fb(y1_b) - Fb(star_b)) / Lb - sp.Rational(1, 4) * e0b**2
RHS_one = Tbase - Sbase
verify_exact("N=1 complete certificate", LHS_one - RHS_one, pm_one)
analytic_formula_sources.boundary-check:
# Terminal update N>=2: use the same actual update, now with no remaining position term.
ctx_step.set_as_current()
boundary_map = {
    key: sp.cancel(value.subs(j_s, n_s)) if isinstance(value, sp.Basic) else value
    for key, value in resolved_step.items()
}
boundary_map["E_{step}"] = Hs(n_s) * (Hs(n_s) - 1) / 2
boundary_map["cnew_{step}"] = sp.S(0)
boundary_map["dnew_{step}"] = sp.S(0)
# Wnew also contains -a_N <e_N,x_N>; the terminal potential omits that whole quadratic.
LHS_boundary = (Fs(yn) - Fs(star)) / Ls - Wprev
RHS_boundary = Tstep - Sstep
diff_boundary = LHS_boundary - RHS_boundary
pm_boundary = pf.ExpressionManager(ctx_step, resolve_parameters=boundary_map)
proof_checks["boundary"] = verify_exact(
    "Terminal step (N>=2)", diff_boundary, pm_boundary
)
boundary_delay_map = {**boundary_map, "tau_{step}": 1 / (4 * Hs(n_s))}
pm_boundary_delay = pf.ExpressionManager(
    ctx_step, resolve_parameters=boundary_delay_map
)
verify_exact(
    "N=2 delayed-square terminal correction",
    ((Fs(yn) - Fs(star)) / Ls - (Wprev + delay))
    - ((Tstep - Sstep) - delay)
    - diff_boundary,
    pm_boundary_delay,
)
analytic_formula_sources.normalization-check:
# The final potential controls exactly the requested metric and radius normalization.
ctx_norm = pf.PEPContext("symbolic_normalization").set_as_current()
e_initial = pf.Vector(is_basis=True, tags=["e_0"])
gap_final = pf.Scalar(is_basis=True, tags=["F(y_N)-F(x_star)"])
Ln, Rn, Tn = (
    pf.Parameter("L_{norm}"),
    pf.Parameter("R_{norm}"),
    pf.Parameter("tau_{norm}"),
)
V_terminal = gap_final / Ln - Tn * e_initial**2
LHS_normalization = gap_final - Ln * Tn * Rn**2
RHS_normalization = Ln * V_terminal + Ln * Tn * (e_initial**2 - Rn**2)
pm_norm = pf.ExpressionManager(
    ctx_norm,
    resolve_parameters={
        "L_{norm}": L_s,
        "R_{norm}": R_s,
        "tau_{norm}": 1 / (4 * Hs(n_s)),
    },
)
proof_checks["normalization"] = verify_exact(
    "Radius and terminal normalization", LHS_normalization - RHS_normalization, pm_norm
)
assert (
    sp.cancel(
        L_s * R_s**2 / (4 * Hs(n_s)) - 2 * L_s * R_s**2 / (n_s * n_s + 5 * n_s + 2)
    )
    == 0
)
